author: Deeesp
body:
Hey. So, I was playing Walls on Mesoplanet, and I tried to use the teleporter, but I got glitched in it. The Moderator saw me flying, he thought I was hacking, but it was the glitch, I couldn't move. After I used the command /leave I got banned for "Hacking-Flying".It is just a misunderstanding.
- CoCo_Debby
